note: Curated conflicts and tension areas for the conflict tracker (docs/04 section 5.1). Bounding boxes are west, south, east, north in WGS84 and are deliberately generous. Seeded 5 September 2026; admin editing is a later follow-up.

conflicts.name: Russia's war in Ukraine
conflicts.summary: Full-scale war since February 2022 along a front in the east and south, with long-range strikes across the country and into Russia.

conflicts.name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank
conflicts.summary: War in Gaza since October 2023 with recurring operations in the West Bank.

conflicts.name: Israel and Hezbollah
conflicts.summary: Cross-border conflict along the Blue Line under a fragile ceasefire.

conflicts.name: Sudan civil war
conflicts.summary: War between the army and the Rapid Support Forces since April 2023, with famine and mass displacement.

conflicts.name: Yemen and the Red Sea
conflicts.summary: Civil war and Houthi attacks on Red Sea shipping with US, UK and Israeli strikes in reply.

conflicts.name: Central Sahel insurgency
conflicts.summary: Jihadist insurgency across three junta-led states with Russian-backed forces replacing Western missions.

conflicts.name: Eastern DR Congo
conflicts.summary: M23 offensive holding Goma and Bukavu with regional mediation and a fragile ceasefire.

conflicts.name: Myanmar civil war
conflicts.summary: Nationwide war since the 2021 coup, with the junta losing ground in the borderlands.

conflicts.name: Somalia
conflicts.summary: Long insurgency around Mogadishu and the central regions, with Islamic State active in Puntland.

conflicts.name: Syria
conflicts.summary: Post-Assad transition with sectarian violence, Israeli strikes and an unresolved north-east.

conflicts.name: Haiti gang conflict
conflicts.summary: Gangs control most of the capital; an international force supports the police.

conflicts.name: Ethiopia
conflicts.summary: Insurgencies in Amhara and Oromia and a fragile Tigray settlement, with Eritrea tension.

conflicts.name: Northern Nigeria
conflicts.summary: Jihadist insurgency in the north-east and banditry across the north-west.

conflicts.name: Cabo Delgado insurgency
conflicts.summary: Islamic State affiliate insurgency in the gas-rich north of Mozambique.

conflicts.name: Libya
conflicts.summary: Divided government with recurring militia clashes in Tripoli.

conflicts.name: Taiwan Strait
conflicts.summary: Sustained Chinese military pressure around Taiwan with periodic large exercises.

conflicts.name: Korean peninsula
conflicts.summary: Missile tests, nuclear posture and the North's alignment with Russia.

conflicts.name: South China Sea
conflicts.summary: Confrontations between Chinese and Philippine vessels around disputed shoals.

conflicts.name: India and Pakistan
conflicts.summary: Nuclear-armed rivals with periodic strikes across the Line of Control.

conflicts.name: Armenia and Azerbaijan
conflicts.summary: Post-Karabakh peace process with border incidents and the Zangezur corridor question.

conflicts.name: Colombia
conflicts.summary: Fragmented armed groups fighting over coca corridors as peace talks stall.

conflicts.name: Pakistan and Afghanistan border
conflicts.summary: TTP and Baloch insurgencies in Pakistan with cross-border strikes into Afghanistan.

conflicts.name: Iran and Israel
conflicts.summary: Direct exchanges of strikes since 2024 and the unresolved nuclear question.
